title: ArchSpace: Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing LLM Architecture Research
topic: 训练预算与公平架构比较
code_status: 作者公开架构提案/记录平台仓库；不等同本地已运行原始大规模训练或作者拟合数据。
local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.foundation_models.archspace import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(42, device="cpu"))'

cost_assessment.source: Fixed v1 Figure 2, Sections 3/4 and Appendix C; https://arxiv.org/html/2611.17332v1
cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: Five FLOP budgets from 1e18 to 1e20; 4--6 model sizes per budget and LR/BS sweeps for two baselines; Phase II 1B models trained on 150B+10B tokens.
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: The grid and subsequent 160B-token training exceed a short single-device budget; no training was attempted.
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅实现公开系数的coupled scaling/cosh损失与预算最优点算术，不拟合新数据、不自动搜索架构、不接入Evolve。

summary: 以相同数据/tokenizer和完整学习率衰减后的多域validation比较架构，用模型FLOPs/token、token数与LR/BS耦合cosh项描述训练损失。本地只复算公开Qwen3.5/OLMo3系数及预算约束，不是架构搜索系统；完整实验高成本不复现。
